title: Groups test coverage gaps: multi-rekey stacking, admin-demotion negative, concurrency hooks
description: test_groups_rekey.py covers single rotation + grace boundary + prune-to-empty; missing N sequential rekeys stacking retired_epochs, double-prune idempotency assertion, admin-removal negative case (masks removed-admin defect), interleaving hooks for invitation store. Structural atomicity fine under cooperative asyncio; evidentiary gap only. File under review-coverage sweep.
close_reason: Added the two dispatcher-scoped evidentiary tests to existing new-style test_groups_rekey.py: (1) test_sequential_rekeys_stack_retired_epochs_with_prune_boundaries - 3 sequential rekeys stacking retired epochs [1] -> [1,2] -> (prune-on-read drops 1 at exact strict-boundary t0+3600) [2] -> [2,3], with epoch_accepted False/True probes at every exact expiry boundary and full stack equality pinned each step; final prune-on-read empties stack while live epoch-4 material asserted intact. (2) test_double_prune_is_idempotent_and_concurrency_free - two-entry stack, first mutating pass drops exactly one (pre/post lengths and full literal survivor entry), second identical pass proven zero-drop by deep equality of state snapshot AND returned material; sequential-only under the mutation lock, no fake async, docstring states why cooperative asyncio makes that the concurrency-relevant contract. Oracles are hand-derived construction values: key_ids from the key-{gid}-{epoch:03d} format, expires = rekey stamp + REKEY_GRACE_S arithmetic done offline, secrets/salts captured once at creation/rotation time; zero runtime echoes. Bead's other items (admin-demotion negative, invitation-store interleave hooks) intentionally not attempted here - outside the dispatcher's scoping for this leaf and group_membership/groups_invite signing+ledger logic is owned by in-flight beads. Verification: pytest tests/coap -k group = 78 passed; ruff clean on both touched files.
